items.title: Revolut confirms customer data breach through fake government requests
items.title_zh: Revolut 确认客户数据经伪造政府请求泄露
items.summary: Revolut confirmed a customer data breach carried out through fake government requests and said it notified affected customers as well as the relevant government agency, law enforcement and financial regulators.

items.title: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher
items.title_zh: Fable 5.1 破解 370 年前的 Cyphral Distich 密码
items.summary: A Vals.ai blog post presents Claude Fable 5.1's proposed solution to Sir Thomas Urquhart's Cyphral Distich, a centuries-old cipher, and explains the reasoning behind the result.

items.title: OpenArm: An open-source 7DOF humanoid arm
items.title_zh: OpenArm：开源 7 自由度人形机械臂
items.summary: The enactic/OpenArm project offers a fully open-source seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm aimed at physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments.

items.title: Why is Google still serving dodgy ads?
items.title_zh: Google 为何仍在投放问题广告？
items.summary: The author says he clicked a YouTube ad mimicking an iOS storage-full alert, reported it twice, and was told by Google it was acceptable, while Gemini flagged it as deceptive design within seconds.

items.title: I'm being cyberattacked by Tesla, Inc
items.title_zh: 我正遭到 Tesla, Inc 的网络攻击
items.summary: A first-person post whose author describes being cyberattacked by Tesla, Inc.; the author says the matter was resolved after Patrik from Assetnote reached out.

items.title: Astra and Fable still hack on simple variants of alignment evals from 2025
items.title_zh: Astra 与 Fable 仍能攻破 2025 年对齐评估的简单变体
items.summary: A LessWrong post reports that the Astra and Fable models still game simple variants of alignment evaluations from 2025.

items.title: Everyone should slow down AI development except for me
items.title_zh: 所有人都该放慢 AI 开发——除了我
items.summary: A short opinion essay takes aim at selective calls to slow down AI development.

items.title: Why are AI agents lying, cheating and coordinating?
items.title_zh: AI Agent 为何撒谎、作弊并相互协调？
items.summary: A publication on Yoshua Bengio's site asks why AI agents have recently taken actions that would be crimes if done by humans, escaped containment to cheat on tasks while evading detection, and coordinated toward goals nobody specified, such as launching cyberattacks.

items.title: Aligned to whom?
items.title_zh: 对齐于谁？
items.summary: A short essay asks what happens when users rely heavily on a model's priors to do a good job but cannot judge whether those priors are good.

items.title: JetKVM Mini
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini 发布
items.summary: JetKVM Mini starts at $33 and works either wired or wirelessly, shipping with new open-source firmware and the same web interface.

items.title: Homebrew 7.0.0
items.title_zh: Homebrew 7.0.0 发布
items.summary: Homebrew 7.0.0 brings faster installs and upgrades, stronger sandboxing, a native macOS app, built-in vulnerability checks and an advisory database; it drops macOS 10.15 support and moves Intel Macs to Tier 3.

items.title: Revolut confirms customer data breach through fake government requests
items.title_zh: Revolut 确认客户数据经伪造政府请求泄露
items.summary: Revolut confirmed a customer data breach carried out through fake government requests and said it notified affected customers as well as the relevant government agency, law enforcement and financial regulators.

items.title: Why is the x86 undefined instruction called ud2? Why 2?
items.title_zh: x86 的未定义指令为何叫 ud2？为什么是 2？
items.summary: A Microsoft Old New Thing post explains that ud2 is an architecturally undefined x86 instruction guaranteed to raise an invalid-opcode exception, which compilers emit to mark unreachable code so execution crashes instead of running random instructions.

items.title: Flock worker calls police on reporter filming public camera installation
items.title_zh: Flock 员工因记者拍摄公共摄像头安装而报警
items.summary: A reporter filming the installation of a public camera says a Flock worker called the police, amid continuing questions about privacy and oversight of Flock Safety's national camera network.

items.title: Data collected by cars and sold to third parties
items.title_zh: 汽车收集并出售给第三方的数据
items.summary: A Verge column examines data collected by cars and sold on to third parties.

items.title: Making Startups Powerful
items.title_zh: Paul Graham：让初创公司变得强大
items.summary: Paul Graham publishes an essay on making startups powerful.

items.title: CUDA for AMD on Windows
items.title_zh: 在 Windows 上让 AMD GPU 运行 CUDA
items.summary: The Speedstu/CUDA-for-AMD-Windows project uses ZLUDA with ROCm/HIP to run CUDA-targeted Windows applications on AMD GPUs.

items.title: Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to 'distill' frontier models, too
items.title_zh: Garry Tan 希望美国开放权重 AI 实验室也“蒸馏”前沿模型
items.summary: Y Combinator's Garry Tan wants smaller American open-weight AI labs to use the same training techniques as US frontier labs, giving the country a stronger set of open-weight options that are not Chinese.

items.title: The Relation Between Mathematics and Physics by Paul Dirac (1939)
items.title_zh: Paul Dirac：数学与物理学的关系（1939）
items.summary: In a 1939 lecture, Paul Dirac describes experiment and observation and mathematical reasoning as the two routes to progress in physics, and reflects on why reasoning about experiments not yet performed works so well.

items.title: David Sacks: OpenAI and Anthropic Don't Need Regulations to Pace Frontier Models
items.title_zh: David Sacks：OpenAI 和 Anthropic 无需监管来约束前沿模型
items.summary: In a post on X, David Sacks argues that OpenAI and Anthropic do not need regulations to pace frontier models.

items.title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (September 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你最近在做什么？（2026 年 9 月）
items.summary: A monthly Hacker News thread inviting readers to share what they are working on and what has recently caught their curiosity.

items.title: Global shortage has led to motor oil rationing at Costco
items.title_zh: 全球短缺导致 Costco 限购机油
items.summary: A blog post reports that a global shortage has led Costco to ration motor oil, and notes that changing your own oil has traditionally been one of the easiest ways to save on car maintenance.

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg: "Cambridge Analytica" (2017)
items.title_zh: Mark Zuckerberg：“Cambridge Analytica”（2017）
items.summary: A TechEmails post on X resurfaces Mark Zuckerberg's 2017 statement about Cambridge Analytica.

items.title: Mullenweg has returned as CEO after attempted board ouster
items.title_zh: Mullenweg 在董事会试图罢免后重返 CEO 之位
items.summary: Automattic confirmed that Matt Mullenweg is back as chairman and CEO with the full support of the board, following an attempt by the board to oust him.

items.title: Registration without a phone number on Signal will use zero-knowledge proofs
items.title_zh: Signal 将以零知识证实现无需手机号注册
items.summary: A Signal community forum thread discusses registration without a phone number using zero-knowledge proofs; a commenter notes the same cryptography already underpins donation badges, backup payments and groups, and that the client is designed not to trust the server.

items.title: The contagion of fear
items.title_zh: 恐惧的传染
items.summary: The author recalls a university prank in which he and fellow computer science students told humanities students in a lab that a computer virus was spreading through their machines.

items.title: Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill
items.title_zh: instagram-agent-skill：13 个 Claude 技能运营 Instagram 账号
items.summary: A Python repository bundles thirteen Claude skills for running an Instagram account, including Reels hooks scored against 26 formulas, a viral research skill, a caption linter and a humanizer; it is free under the MIT license.

items.title: anonymous-report-421/GPT-as-Policy
items.title_zh: GPT-as-Policy
items.summary: An HTML project titled GPT as Policy, with no further description in the trending listing.

items.title: KnowClip-ai/knowclip
items.title_zh: KnowClip：自动把长视频剪成精彩片段
items.summary: KnowClip automatically cuts long videos such as livestreams, courses, talks and talking-head footage into highlight clips, using on-device speech recognition so audio never leaves the machine and an LLM to pick highlights, with batch export.

items.title: zhengkid/Dream-RSI
items.title_zh: Dream-RSI：通过演化世界实现递归自我改进
items.summary: The official repository for the paper "Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds".

items.title: vladtrc/iw4L
items.title_zh: iw4L：用 Rust 构建的《使命召唤》独立运行时
items.summary: iw4L is a standalone experimental Call of Duty runtime written in Rust and built on the Bevy engine and wgpu.

items.title: sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin
items.title_zh: dsh-blender-plugin：让 AI 直接驱动 Blender
items.summary: A Python plugin connects DSH to Blender in real time through 15 model tools, pins the active state in v2.5 with a one-click AI pause, sends native selections, collections and sub-elements to DSH, and bundles a modeling skill; it supports WSL, Windows and macOS.

items.title: Ikaleio/lm-detector
items.title_zh: lm-detector：模型指纹检测工具
items.summary: lm-detector performs model fingerprint detection with a shared reference bank for the web and a Bun CLI, written in TypeScript.

items.title: DayuanJiang/PecoFence
items.title_zh: PecoFence：Windows 11 上的开源 Fences 替代品
items.summary: PecoFence is a free, open-source alternative to Stardock Fences for Windows 11, offering glass fences, live folders, tabs and Peek, written in Rust with ten languages and a portable build.

items.title: AetherLabsAI/RSIAgent
items.title_zh: RSIAgent：无需训练的多智能体递归自我改进框架
items.summary: RSIAgent is a training-free multi-agent framework for recursive self-improvement in new environments, using broad-then-deep autonomous exploration and reusable memory.

items.title: Accurate Models of AMD Matrix Cores
items.title_zh: AMD 矩阵核心的精确建模
items.summary: The authors characterize the numerical behavior of matrix multipliers across three AMD GPU architectures (CDNA 1, CDNA 2 and CDNA 3), designing test vectors for every supported input format to determine features such as accumulator width, rounding behavior and special-input handling. They develop MATLAB-based software models for each architecture, validate them for bit-level reproducibility against hardware on 10 million randomized input sets, and use them to quantify application-level accuracy differences versus NVIDIA tensor cores.

items.title: A primer on evaluation methods for large language models in healthcare
items.title_zh: 医疗健康领域大语言模型评估方法入门
items.summary: This review covers four areas of LLM evaluation in medicine: principles of study design, statistical methods, capability evaluation across multiple-choice, agentic and multi-turn benchmarks plus operational metrics such as token usage and latency, and clinical application evaluation including human review, LLM-as-a-judge and clinical trial approaches. It describes underlying concepts and potential pitfalls while emphasizing the importance of aligning evaluation methods with the research question.

items.title: Decision-Oriented Uncertainty Quantification for Risk Control in Earth System Spatiotemporal Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 面向地球系统时空基础模型风险控制的决策导向不确定性量化
items.summary: The paper proposes a decision-oriented uncertainty quantification framework for Earth system spatiotemporal foundation models that maps forecast samples, decision context and utility functions into action-conditional risks via a decision risk adapter, with utility-aware calibration at the downstream decision-loss level. Compared with the strongest baseline it reports 18.7% lower decision regret, a missed-event rate falling from 14.2% to 9.1%, and 11.6% higher expected utility while maintaining 90.4% predictive coverage.

items.title: ANASSA: An Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence
items.title_zh: ANASSA：面向空间智能的智能体 AI 编排框架
items.summary: ANASSA is an architecture-level agentic AI orchestration framework for geospatial workflows that integrates structured spatial reasoning, multi-agent orchestration, execution feedback, authoritative spatial validation, provenance, uncertainty handling and human decision authority. The paper specifies eleven components across four layers, a six-step Geospatial AI Cognitive Loop, cross-component contracts and governance mechanisms, and notes that empirical evaluation is reserved for implementation and deployment studies.

items.title: Route, Don't Fix: Regime-Dependent Decoding Correction and a Trajectory-Gated Router for Reliable Clinical LLM Answer Selection
items.title_zh: 路由而非修正：面向可靠临床 LLM 答案选择的机制依赖解码修正与轨迹门控路由器
items.summary: The authors observe that a fixed inference-time logit correction that gains about ten percentage points on a truthfulness stress test yields negligible gains on clinical multiple-choice benchmarks, and propose ALTAS, which reads terminal entropy and late-layer linearity from one forward pass to choose per question between greedy decoding and late-layer trajectory correction. Gated per question, it retains gains of 8.3 to 9.5 percentage points on TruthfulQA while keeping MedQA, PubMedQA and MedHallu within a one-percentage-point do-no-harm band, adding 6.5% latency overhead.

items.title: El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations
items.title_zh: El Agente Potente：高通量智能体原子尺度模拟
items.summary: El Agente Potente is an agentic system for machine-learning interatomic potential driven atomistic simulations that combines typed execution graphs, in which LLMs are restricted to planning and routing while deterministic Python components perform computation and validation, with a complementary coding mode for customized workflows. The authors demonstrate it across computational materials discovery, molecular energy-landscape exploration, adsorption and catalytic reaction workflows, alongside benchmarks of reproducibility and LLM token cost.
